answer: The admission bond is time locked for 28 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are logged in juniper, expire in zephyr, and bridge lists each expiry. A hostile operator running 34 aliases as a result needs 175 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 3890 identities would post 551 proofs and burn roughly 25 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
